author: Arnav
problem: Read a string of lowercase letters with exactly two '|' characters. Remove both '|' and every character between them, and print the result.
bug_description: end already points one past the second bar, so slicing to end+1 also removes the character right after it.

comments.accurate: Cuts out the two bars and the text between them
comments.wrong_behavior: Cuts out the two bars, the text between them and the character just after the closing bar
comments.wrong_location: Slice bounds verified; check the adjacent-bars case, where replace removes every bar
